description: This file defines a PHP class EmployeeJobDetailAPI which provides API endpoints for getting and updating employee job details in a human resource management system. It includes methods for retrieving an employee's job details, updating them, and validation rules; it also handles PHPDoc annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: EmployeeJobDetailAPI
classes.description: PHP class providing API endpoints for retrieving and updating employee job details within the HRM system, implementing validation rules and integrating with employee service and models.

methods.description: Handles PUT request to update a specific employee's job details, including validation, updating employee entity, and dispatching change events.
